status: Verdicts of lane GX, computed from finished logged runs and the frozen cache: docs/13 A3 H8.5 (confirmatory) and H8.6 (placement, no threshold); docs/13 A4 H9.7 pilot (exploratory, seed 100) and gate G1 frame. CPU only; no GPU; validation split only; the test split is never loaded.
inputs: --fit-energy, --matched, --matched-rerun (only when the H8.5 rule triggered it; checked), --t600, --tuned-lrsel, --tuned-600: run directories; every run must have exit status 0; the energy runs must carry gpu_lock_mode exclusive

bootstrap.function: tmlm.cvtm.protocol.bootstrap_bpb (paired: per-document bits of the CVTM-core from cache/validation/core_p_gold.npy minus the transformer's from its per-token file)
bootstrap.label: derived

launch: scripts/cpu_slot.sh 1 -- scripts/run_logged.py --name cvtm_GX_verdicts --config experiments/cvtm/configs/GX_verdicts.json -- .venv-tm/bin/python -u experiments/cvtm_energy.py --mode verdict --config experiments/cvtm/configs/GX_verdicts.json --fit-energy results/<...> --matched results/<...> [--matched-rerun results/<...>] --t600 results/<...> --tuned-lrsel results/<...> --tuned-600 results/<...>
